stories.title: Dode en gewonden na nieuwe aanval op vliegveld Riyad

en.title: Death and injuries in new attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack occurred at Riyadh airport resulting in fatalities and injuries.

stories.title: Twee doden en twee gewonden bij verkeersongeluk Kesteren

en.title: Two dead and two injured in traffic accident at Kesteren
en.summary: A serious traffic collision on the N233 near Kesteren resulted in two deaths and two injuries, with emergency services responding to the scene.

stories.title: Dode en 11 gewonden bij aanval op luchthaven Riyad

en.title: Death and 11 injured in attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport resulted in one death and eleven injuries, with the victim holding Pakistani nationality and material damage also reported.

stories.title: Twee doden en twee gewonden door ongeval op N233 bij Kesteren

en.title: Two dead and two injured by accident on N233 near Kesteren
en.summary: A traffic accident on the N233 in Kesteren on Sunday resulted in two fatalities and two people being hospitalized with injuries.

stories.title: Strand Scheveningen tijd lang afgezet: 'zeemijn' blijkt ongevaarlijke stalen bal

en.title: Scheveningen beach closed temporarily: 'sea mine' turns out to be harmless steel ball
en.summary: A metal ball that washed ashore on a Dutch beach prompted authorities to close the area and investigate with military bomb disposal experts, but it was determined to be harmless.

stories.title: Herten in Maasland dood nadat ze waren gevoerd met ongekookte rijst

en.title: Deer in Maasland die after being fed uncooked rice
en.summary: Five deer at a wildlife facility in the Netherlands died after someone apparently placed uncooked rice in their food container, which caused illness in the animals.

stories.title: Video | Defensie onderzoekt aangespoelde stalen bol op strand Scheveningen

en.title: Video | Defense investigates steel sphere washed ashore on Scheveningen beach
en.summary: Military personnel examined a steel sphere that washed up on a Dutch beach.

stories.title: Litouwer krijgt onterecht ingenomen jackpot van 24.000 euro terug

en.title: Lithuanian man receives wrongfully seized jackpot of 24,000 euros back
en.summary: The Dutch military police incorrectly confiscated 24,150 euros from a Lithuanian man found sleeping in his car in Venlo last month. The man was later confirmed to have legitimately won the money.

stories.title: Franse sociaaldemocraten schuiven Europarlementariër Raphaël Glucksmann naar voren voor presidentsverkiezingen

en.title: French social democrats put forward Member of European Parliament Raphaël Glucksmann for presidential election
en.summary: French social democrats have nominated European Parliament member Raphaël Glucksmann as their candidate for the upcoming presidential election.

stories.title: Met Glucksmann als kandidaat is brede linkse samenwerking voor Franse presidentsverkiezingen verder weg dan ooit

en.title: With Glucksmann as candidate, broad left-wing cooperation for French presidential election further away than ever
en.summary: Raphaël Glucksmann won the center-left primary for the French presidency, strengthening the political center but making broader left-wing collaboration more difficult.

stories.title: Saudi-Arabië zal 'stevig terugslaan' na Houthi-aanval op luchthaven Riyad

en.title: Saudi Arabia will 'strike back hard' after Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: Houthi forces struck Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport, prompting international concern about escalation. Saudi Arabia pledges a strong response while fighting continues between Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen.

stories.title: Man in Polen opgepakt voor het plannen van een aanslag op premier Tusk

en.title: Man arrested in Poland for planning attack on Prime Minister Tusk
en.summary: Polish authorities arrested a suspect for preparing an attack on Prime Minister Tusk. The suspect's identity, background, and method remain undisclosed, though Tusk thanked police for swift action.
